settings.title: FALLON TAYLOR
settings.text: Fallon is just your average horse fanatic chick...with a twist. Fallon is the 2014 WNFR World Champion Barrel Racer and the 2018 AQHA World Champion Barrel Racer. In the middle of training her own horses and being on the rodeo road Fallon is also a YouTube vlogger, online coach to barrel racers all over the world, and entrepreneur!

settings.testimonial: I cannot say enough great things about Ranch Dress'n! Their customer service is excellent and there shipping is FAST! Not to mention that nothing is overpriced or of poor quality. I honestly don't shop anywhere else!
settings.author: Morgan

settings.testimonial:
Oh My Lord, how I love Ranch Dress'n ! I have ordered many times and I keep on ordering! 
The t-shirts are amazing, the fabric is soft & light. The sweat-shrirts are cozy and soft as well. Amazing merchandise!
settings.author: Rainy

settings.testimonial: I love Ranch Dress'n because they have the most amazing clothes for adult women and youth. My daughter rodeos and everyone always compliments her on her outfits!
settings.author: Jennifer

settings.testimonial: I love Ranch Dress'n...it’s so classy. All of the clothes are super true to size and they are all so cute! I have a ton of things from Ranch Dress'n and even the saddle sacks are super amazing and they work so well! They are great with listing new items and I will never stop shopping here!"
settings.author: Daizee

settings.testimonial: I absolutely love Ranch Dress’n!! They are awesome they have plenty of options for clothing and they even have plus size options. When I ordered my last T-shirt Fallon Taylor, the owner, called me and left me a voicemail with a discount code! I love ordering from them it’s my favorite!
settings.author: Analiese

settings.testimonial: I love that Ranch Dressin' doesn't forget about us plus size girls! They have an amazing selection of Western style clothing that aren't toned down like many other brands for a bigger body. Definitely my new go to!
settings.author: Brandy

settings.testimonial: I’m loving Ranch Dressen, I recently ordered my first thing… a saddle sack due to the new design and I got it supper quick! Normally places besides Amazon can take a while but it didn’t, which I love! After I got a discount code from ordering, I am ordering again! I’m really impressed so far by the selections of the sizes!
settings.author: Olivia

settings.testimonial: I love how Ranch Dress’n is so personable! I love the Instagram page and how  passionate Fallon is about her clothing. I can find jeans that are long enough and my style. Being a 6’1 girl can be tricky finding jeans, especially cute ones. I feel like I can relate to Fallon Taylor which makes me come back for more goodies every time.
settings.author: Cindy

settings.testimonial: Everything is always true to size and delivered fast and in perfect condition! I've never had a complaint and I'm sure I never will! On top of all that their designs are truly innovative to the western world and I love it!! Plus the team behind it all are amazing and inspiring women!
settings.author: Jessica

settings.text: Ranch Dress'n: Not just another western boutique, Ranch Dressn offers inclusive western-inspired apparel to make you feel comfortable and confident in and out of the arena! Western Our Way!
